extends.notInherited: E04 singleton-layer/path/center-only extraction and its old admission guards; E05 ports the full observed routing family below.

scope.ports: Each implicit port belongs to exactly one directed segment, EAST output or WEST input, between adjacent layers.
scope.options: Default edgeEdgeBetweenLayers=10, edgeNodeBetweenLayers=10, no explicit node alignment; public nodeNodeBetweenLayers is resolved normally.

guardProofs.claim: The admitted flat simple DAG is acyclic before split; approved splitting creates adjacent-layer NORMAL/LONG_EDGE work. Each private port is created per edge endpoint and has one incident segment. Therefore each initial hyperedge segment has one incoming and one outgoing coordinate; sourceHashMap is lookup-only by port identity. No EXTERNAL_PORT/NORTH_SOUTH/HYPERNODE/label/self-loop graph flag or feedback option is introduced, so optional router configurations remain guarded out.

Preserve max margins, default ratio out-port-count/(in+out), half-ratio for isolated node, source clamp order and left-to-right layer traversal. Route before assigning right-layer x is valid because the strategy reads only y anchors. Preserve slot-count routingWidth and max-with-node-spacing arithmetic in source order, including first/last boundary calls and final graph.size.x.

Coordinates are finite IEEE doubles. Source insertSorted de-duplicates equal numeric values; floatValue returns the same generated number, not float32. minimumDifference first uses natural compare_3 (including -0 before +0), then distinct uses generated Double primitive ===, merging the two signed zeros while retaining sorted -0. Use that comparator plus linear numeric == distinct, not an unproved set/sort rewrite. The seven original-helper vectors independently establish the signed-zero/duplicate/subnormal cases. Keep source strict critical/conflict inequalities, endpoint-inclusive crossings, weight16, bidirectional zero-weight ties, and Double.MAX_VALUE initial state. Dynamic critical threshold is0.2*min(incoming,outgoing), never a hardcoded spacing guess.

Implement actual ordered source/sink draining, critical-positive preference, maximum outflow scan, source nextInt even for bound1, normalization, and dependency reversal/deletion. Unprocessed TreeSet order is ascending unique initial negative mark. HyperEdgeSegment.equals/hash use mark; after initialize/detect all keys used by TreeSet/LinkedHashSet have unique stable marks, making identity membership equivalent only under this invariant. New split partners are not inserted into the old selected set; next detect reinitializes unique marks. No inference that router RNG is absent: crossing-six observes one31-bit draw.

Critical dependencies>=2 trigger actual cycle detection, ordered selected segments, stable length sorting, free area rating and source splitBy/splitPartner. Keep original selected-index ties, midpoint fallback, gap reuse and remove/append dependency writes. Area-rating temporary extents are recomputed when constructed; changing their coordinate lists in rateArea does not trigger an invented recompute. Do not omit rare rating branches simply because current samples use one area.

Preserve full dependency counts including retained zero-weight links, FIFO sources, rank max updates and rightward-target backward pass. No external side is assumed from absent ports. Do not replace dependency routing with edge order or one fixed slot per layer.

Preserve WestToEast virtual dispatch, split-partner-only early return, exact anchor addition order, strict abs(sourceY-targetY)>0.001 bend branch, source2/4-point sequences and junction point boundary tests. Clone junction positions, share A long_edges.get_junction_points for actual mutable-default materialization, and clear the per-boundary value-set. Point membership compares exact finite x/y values. Source straightness epsilon is not the JSON comparison tolerance, which remains unchanged.

Original<=8 DAG has at most28 edges; approved longest-span splitting lemma gives<=56 dummy nodes, <=64 work nodes, <=84 work edges and<=168 ports. At most84 initial edge segments in any boundary and at most168 after one split per selected segment. Each private initial/split segment has at most two distinct connection coordinates, so conflict/crossing counts and weight16 remain small signed32 integers even under a conservative four dependencies per ordered pair. All coordinates retain finite bounded-double arithmetic; no Python arbitrary-precision behavior is used to excuse different overflow.

reads: ordered layers/node widths, margins and port lists
finite node/port positions and zero-size anchors
effective nodeNodeBetweenLayers and fixed private edge spacing defaults
writes: temporary ordered segment/dependency state and shared RNG state

hostMappingRefs.scope: Immutable existing source bindings for GWT list/identity/property primitives; E04 algorithm path simplification is not inherited.
Generated JavaRandom48 state and next_int implementation reused; do not use Python random.
Seven actual original generated numeric-helper observations, including signed zero; evidence supports the included static sorted/distinct proof, not algorithm acceptance.

hostMappingDelta.identity: Python graph/port/dependency objects use identity. Segment-key containers may use identity only while source marks are unique; source mark equality is not claimed as generic identity equality.
hostMappingDelta.order: Lists/FIFO, stable float compare, sorted unique marks for TreeSet, insertion-ordered selected segments; no unordered set determines routing.
hostMappingDelta.mutableDefaults: A-owned long_edges.get_junction_points mirrors missing->clone/store list and preserves an existing empty list.
hostMappingDelta.dispatch: Direction0 constructs WestToEastRoutingStrategy; inherited names calculateBendPoints/getPortPositionOnHyperNode/getSourcePortSide/getTargetPortSide resolve to the included _1 methods. Other directions stay excluded.
hostMappingDelta.fusion: A stateless HyperEdgeSegmentSplitter object storing routingGenerator may be represented by private functions receiving that generator; no layout state or branch may be skipped.

numericSemantics: source integer counts bounded below signed32
no coordinate translation or fixture lookup

evidence.kind: optional actual observations, not a proof or fresh-session dependency
38 same-request observations across original/pretty/instrumented sources; absence from coverage is not nonexecution

limitation: Routing source proposal only. Independent review/root approval precede mechanical Python port and runtime acceptance.
